text: ___ is a graph neural network trained on PDB structures that takes a fixed protein backbone (Cα, Cβ, N, C coordinates) as input and outputs an amino acid probability distribution at each position; it runs in seconds and is commonly paired with RFdiffusion in protein design pipelines.
explanation: ProteinMPNN takes backbone coordinates and predicts a sequence likely to fold into that backbone, running in roughly seconds per design, which is why it is used downstream of RFdiffusion-generated backbones in modern design pipelines (RFdiffusion → ProteinMPNN → AlphaFold validation). Rosetta also does sequence design but is a Monte Carlo energy-function search, not a graph neural network, and ESM-2 is a general protein language model rather than a backbone-conditioned design tool.
